question: In which country do MOST people with diabetes live?

post.premise: One country holds a quarter of the world's diabetes
post.bait: It is not the United States.
keywords: which country has the most diabetes
post.sources_line: IDF Diabetes Atlas, 11th edition (2025); CDC National Diabetes Statistics Report; WHO

youtube.title: Which country has the most diabetes in the world? Not the USA 🩸
youtube.description:
India, the United States or the third one? One country is home to a quarter of every adult with diabetes on the planet, and about half of them do not know it yet.
Guess before the map fills, then see the three countries side by side, the global count climb, and the birthday that gave World Diabetes Day its date.
Which flag did you pick?

threads.text: In which country do most people with diabetes live — India, the United States or China? One country holds a quarter of every adult case on Earth, about half of them undiagnosed, and World Diabetes Day falls on a doctor's birthday for a reason.

intent: The World Diabetes Day map: not the United States but China, home to a quarter of all adults with diabetes — three countries compared side by side, the global count climbing past half a billion with half undiagnosed, and the Toronto pin for the doctor whose birthday the day marks.

v04.text: China. About 148 million adults there live with diabetes, 1 in 4 of all cases on Earth.

v05.text: India is second with about 90 million. The United States has 38 million.

v06.text: Worldwide it is well over half a billion people, and around half of them do not yet know they have it.

v07.text: The 14th of November is World Diabetes Day, the birthday of the doctor who helped discover insulin.

research.topic: Country with the most adults living with diabetes: China — 148.0 million adults aged 20–79 (IDF Diabetes Atlas 11th ed., 2025, data for 2024), about 1 in 4 of the 589 million worldwide; India 89.8 million second; United States ≈ 38 million (CDC 38.4 M all ages, 2021); worldwide 11.1 % of adults, ~4 in 10 undiagnosed globally and about half in the Western Pacific; World Diabetes Day 14 November = Frederick Banting's birthday (insulin discovered in Toronto, 1921)

myths.myth: The United States has the most people with diabetes.
myths.reality: China has about 148 million adults with diabetes, India about 90 million; the United States has about 38 million.

landscape.our_gap: Diabetes Shorts are symptom lists and diet tips; nobody asks the where question on a map, compares the three countries, counts the world and ties the date to the Toronto discovery.

idf_atlas.title: IDF Diabetes Atlas, 11th edition (2025)
idf_atlas.notes: 589 million adults (20–79) with diabetes in 2024, 11.1 % of adults; China 148.0 million (most), India 89.8 million (second); 4 in 10 undiagnosed worldwide

idf_wp_factsheet.title: IDF Atlas 11th edition — Western Pacific factsheet
idf_wp_factsheet.notes: China accounts for 1 in 4 of all adults living with diabetes worldwide; half of adults with diabetes in the region are undiagnosed

cdc_ndsr.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
cdc_ndsr.title: National Diabetes Statistics Report
cdc_ndsr.notes: 38.4 million Americans of all ages have diabetes (11.6 % of the population), about 8.7 million undiagnosed

who_wdd.title: World Diabetes Day — 14 November
who_wdd.notes: marked on 14 November, the birthday of Sir Frederick Banting, who co-discovered insulin with Charles Best in 1921

britannica_banting.title: Frederick Banting
britannica_banting.notes: born 14 November 1891; discovered insulin with Charles Best at the University of Toronto in 1921; Nobel Prize 1923

who_diabetes.title: Diabetes — fact sheet
who_diabetes.notes: about 830 million people had diabetes in 2022 (all ages, 18+ at 14 %); more than half of adults with diabetes were not on medication; China and India hold the most people with diabetes
